app-templates.message:
fix(quiz): after an answer the focus moves to the feedback

## Intent

After an answer the focus went to the button to the next question, below the background, and the page scrolled the feedback and the start of the explanation out of view. The learner had to scroll back up to read them.

## Key changes

- After "Prüfen" the feedback gets the focus. It sits right above the pressed button, so no scroll is needed, and a screen reader reads it. The next tab stops are the links of the background, then the button to the next question.
- quizTests() checks for every question and at both widths that the top of the feedback is in view, that it has the focus, and that the keyboard reaches the next button.
